title: mors.play (command)
description: Talk Morse back: play text (encoded by the window) or morse on Claude's reply track. The lamp blinks magenta, the tone sounds at a lower pitch than the human's unless silent is set or sound is off, and the symbols appear on the track as they play. Plays queue in order; {text: ""} stops the current play and empties the queue. Each play ends with a mors.played event carrying the id. The key stays live during a play. Keep plays short, and speak after mors.played, not during.

id.description: Your name for this play. It comes back on mors.played.

text.description: What to play, as text. The window encodes it. "" stops and empties the queue.

morse.description: What to play, as elements: . and - only, letters separated by a space, words by " / ". Use text or morse.

wpm.description: Speed of this play in words per minute. Defaults to the window's speed.

silent.description: true blinks the lamp and writes the track without the tone.
